channel.title: Off Road Xtreme - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Off Road Xtreme (offroadxtreme.com)

item.title: Why Lifted Jeep Wrangler And Gladiator Driveshafts Fail—And How To Prevent Becoming A Victim
item.description: Why lifted Jeep Wrangler and Gladiator builds need upgraded Spicer performance driveshafts to driveline failure and lost trail reliability.

item.title: 1984 Jeep CJ-7: Ford V8 Power, Coilovers, And Vintage Style
item.description: This 1984 Jeep CJ-7 build was inspired by the owner's father, who owned a CJ. It has a Ford V8, coilover suspension, and more.

item.title: WARN Introduces The ZEON XC: Big Winch Power In A Smaller, Smarter Package
item.description: WARN Industries introduces the ZEON XC winch. A compact, low-profile winch with up to a 14,000-pound capacity and advanced waterproofing.

item.title: Roush Performance Brings The RT6 Back For 2026 With A Fully Integrated 6-Inch Suspension System
item.description: Roush Performance unveils the 2026 RT6 featuring a fully integrated 6-inch suspension system, 35-inch all-terrain tires, and much more.

item.title: Randy Slawson Makes History At The 2026 Griffin King Of The Hammers
item.description: Randy Slawson makes history with his fourth victory at the 2026 Griffin King of the Hammers, conquering the toughest course in event history.

item.title: Jeep Unleashes The 2026 Wrangler Willys 392: Heritage Meets HEMI Power
item.description: The limited-edition 2026 Jeep Wrangler Willys 392 is a V8 off-roader with 470 horsepower, heritage styling and serious trail capability.

item.title: Easily Run 35s On A Jeep Wrangler With This Bilstein B8 5100 Lift Kit
item.description: Fit 35s with the Bilstein B8 5100 Lift Kit. This 1.5-inch system maintains factory geometry and improves off-road travel.

item.title: 1973 Chevy Crew Cab: Pre-Digital Cummins-Swapped Iron Built To Survive An EMP Attack
item.description: This Cummins-powered 1973 Chevrolet Crew Cab 4x4 pickup is built to be a rugged, EMP-resistant, mechanically simple diesel workhorse.

item.title: 2026 Jeep Gladiator Whitecap: A Heritage Mission Built For The Trail
item.description: The 2026 Jeep Gladiator Whitecap debuts as a heritage-inspired special edition with bold two-tone styling starting at just $495.

item.title: The 2026 Ram Rebel X: Twin-Turbo Torque Meets Trail Tech
item.description: The 2026 Ram 1500 Rebel X returns with 420-hp Hurricane power, exclusive Rough Road Cruise Control, and premium tech starting at $71,930.
